verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an HTTP V2 server-side ingestion endpoint and an Export API for pulling data out, plus cohort upload/export APIs, which could support scripting a bulk import of historical events, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated batch/historical import tool or third-party migration guide. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch import API or CLI for historical event backfill, guidance for importing from other analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel/GA), and any independent confirmation that large-scale historical imports work smoothly.
